rundown: Pirates beat Black Knights 10-6 at Michie Stadium in West Point, NY. Pirates came back: they were down 3-0 at the half. Their win chance dropped as low as 21% along the way.
Scoring: Pirates 1 touchdown and 1 field goal; Black Knights 0 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: J. Dickerson pass to L. Sides for 7 yds, for a TD (A. Conrad KICK) (4th quarter, 4:24).

Leading the way — Pirates: Emory Williams 15/23, 130 yds, 1 INT; TJ Engleman Jr. 22 car, 113 yds; Landon Sides 7 rec, 74 yds, 1 TD. Black Knights: Cale Hellums 7/16, 65 yds, 1 INT, 19 car, 62 yds; Parker Poloskey 5 rec, 58 yds.
Where Pirates won it: they outgained them 318 yards to 264.

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Black Knights closed as 4.5-point favorites and lost outright to Pirates; Pirates won as the underdog at +164; the total closed at 45.5 and they combined for 16, under by 29.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 21, 11:55 AM ET. It had Pirates 37% and Black Knights 63%, projecting Pirates 23 – Black Knights 28.2 (51.1 total, Black Knights by 5.2).

Final: Pirates 10 – Black Knights 6. Wrong winner: it had Black Knights at 63%, and Pirates (37%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Pirates came in with a 8% below average attack and a 5% leakier than average defense (6-4, 22.9 scored and 22.6 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 185 and 180 games of evidence. Projected to score 23, they scored 10 (−13 points, 57% under); projected to allow 28.2, they allowed 6 (−22.2 points, 79% under).

Black Knights came in with a 4% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (5-4, 32.2 scored and 25.3 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 172 and 173 games of evidence. Projected to score 28.2, they scored 6 (−22.2 points, 79% under); projected to allow 23, they allowed 10 (−13 points, 57% under).

The bigger miss was Black Knights' scoring (-22.2 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 16 against 51.1 projected (-35.1), about the 1st percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Pirates by 4 against Black Knights by 5.2 projected, about the 27th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
ARMY ML (-205) at -205: the algo gave it 64% vs 64% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 64%). ECU ML (+170) at +170: the algo gave it 36% vs 36% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+1.7u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 36%). ARMY -4.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. ECU +4.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.1 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 45.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 45.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body: Splits (Action Network): spread: 37% of bets on Pirates, 42% of the money — Pirates covered; total: 71% of bets on the over, 73% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 6% of bets on Pirates, 13% of the money.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.300 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.3 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 143 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Pirates attack ×0.960, defense ×0.960 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
